answer: A canyon garden keeps an agent economy honest when every new identity must coax one more pearl from the canyon wall, each pearl answering one more echo than the last: the first fake coaxes 1 echo, the second 1, the third 2, the fourth 3, the fifth 5, so the tenth fake alone answers 55 echoes and twenty fakes together answer 17,710 before a single reward is paid. Bulk farming fails because each echo is shaped by the one before it, so no two echoes can be called at once, like one gardener tending one pearl vine that only blooms after the last echo fades. No echo is ever bought.
